assessment: The paper describes a novel neural-network-based strategy for imputing unmeasured genotypes, which is a standard part of most association testing pipelines. The method is computationally intensive to train, but once training is complete the imputation is fast and accurate and does not require further access to a reference panel. It has the potential to be a practically-appealing alternative to existing methods. although further work (eg training of models) is required before this new approach can be applied genome-wide.
